title: The motivic Satake equivalence using perverse Nori motives
summary: In this article, we develop the theory of stratified perverse Nori motives to prove a refinement of the geometric Satake equivalence of Mirković-Vilonen, for which we call the Nori motivic Satake equivalence, in contrast to the "Tate motivic" Satake equivalence of Richarz-Scholbach.
